turns.q: Can I add an item to an order I already placed?
turns.replyTail:
You cannot add an item to an order that has already been validated. The current order must be cancelled and refunded, then you can place a new order including the additional item.

If you want, send me your order number, the email address used for the purchase, and the phone number used when ordering so I can check the cancellation options.

turns.q: What happens if it already shipped, can it still be changed?
turns.replyTail:
No. Once the order has been shipped, it cannot be changed directly.

If you need to cancel it, refuse the parcel when it is delivered. It will be returned to the warehouse and the refund process will begin. You can then place a new order with the correct items.

turns.q: Can I combine two separate orders into one shipment?
turns.replyTail:
No. Once separate orders have been validated, they cannot be combined into one shipment. Each order is processed and shipped independently.

If you need the items in a single order, the alternative is to cancel the existing orders if they are still eligible, then place one new order containing all the items.
